'''Voralla''' was the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented [[Mirial/Legends|Mirial]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]].
